remarks: Welcome to this charming upper-level condominium in the desirable city of Whittier, Los Angeles County! This inviting 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home features a spacious open-concept layout, high ceilings, laminate flooring, and a cozy fireplace. Enjoy the beautiful pool view, creating a relaxing atmosphere, along with a private balcony overlooking the surrounding neighborhood. Additional features include indoor laundry, central heating and air conditioning, and two assigned parking spaces—one covered and one uncovered.
